integrity: Analytic probability theorem with independent exact finite-history checks in check.py. Finite enumeration does not prove the asymptotic conditional law; no independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard pair-rate-one Kingman coalescent, n>=3, and conditioning on the (1,n-1) basal split. No central limit at finer scale or extension to other coalescents is claimed. The closest 2020 root-balance paper could be inspected only at abstract level; historical priority is qualified.
title: A basal-singleton rare-event law for Kingman external length
